validation.structuralAudit: passed: final Meshopt decode, 48 native rest bones, normalized finite skin weights, coincident-copy agreement, 3 LODs, 7 clips, sockets and embedded texture decode
validation.blenderPackedRoundtrip: inspected: final packed asset reimported in Blender 4.3.2; rest and 7 clips at 5 phases, 3 LODs and front/both sides, plus rear/low-angle run extrema. Residual attachment-strip stretch remains; not final art sign-off.
validation.runtimeReadiness: ready means source-authorized, structurally valid and available to the existing runtime loader; it does not assert completed gameplay or performance acceptance
validation.browserGameplay: not verified: shell Chromium launch blocked by environment sandbox; cloud browser cannot reach the isolated preview server
knownLimitations: Residual visual limitation: flexible belly/chainmail attachment strips still stretch at extreme run poses, especially from below. The original large body-to-hip sheet is reduced, not every local stretch eliminated; this is not final art sign-off.
LOD1/LOD2 retain visibly faceted armor at close range. LOD0 has 17532 triangles, above the 14500 target; head/tail/paw preservation locks remain enabled.
120 Hz interpolation sampling found up to 0.009405 m ground penetration between baked run keys. No gameplay contact tuning was performed.
Browser gameplay, mounted rider/weapon contact, WebGL/GPU timing and 200v200 performance were not verified in this environment.
validation.productionLoader: passed in Node: unchanged SnowLeopardVisual.preload -> QuadrupedAssetPreload -> GLTFLoader/MeshoptDecoder -> constructor; local file-backed fetch and sharp image decode boundary, no WebGL
